messages.subject: Live music — Jake Essex
messages.body:
Hi,

I'm Natalie — I look after bookings for Jake Essex.

Jake is a professional solo vocalist from Essex. High-energy 50s and 60s
rock and roll. He is the act — no tribute, no jumpsuit. Own PA, no deposit.

Milford already puts live music on nearly every weekend — Saturday nights
and Sunday afternoon at the Sunshine Club. That is his night.

Have a look: www.jakeessex.co.uk

Friday nights, Saturdays, Sundays and functions this year and into 2027. If
a date works, reply here and I'll lock it.

Best regards,
Natalie
